text:
Maya: quick check — we need to lock a time for a 45m security + privacy triage this week to prep for the upcoming compliance audit. who can do Tue/Wed/Thu afternoon? please ping availability and any must-have agenda items.

Alex: Tue afternoon works for me (after 2pm). please put RFC review on the agenda — we need a short callout about the new key-rotation changes.

Jordan: Wed midday is better for privacy team, but I can shift if needed. add a brief access-review: list of service accounts to deprecate.

Sophie: Thu 3pm slot open for me. Also want to discuss telemetry retention policy and whether we need a formal data flow diagram in the pre-read.

Maya: noted. sounds like no single slot fits everyone. Nate, can you run a quick Doodle or is a slack emoji poll fine?

Nate: I can do a 3-option emoji poll here — will post in 2m. also flagging: we should include an item for "canary rollout fallout plan" after the infra changes.

triage-bot: Poll created — react with :one: Tue 2:30–3:15, :two: Wed 12:30–1:15, :three: Thu 3:00–3:45

Maya: thanks @Nate — also adding proposed agenda below. open to edits: 
```
1) Quick roll call & objectives (5m)
2) RFC review: key-rotation + canary fallback (10m) — Alex
3) Threat model update & data-flow gaps (10m) — Jordan/Sophie
4) Access review & deprecations (10m) — Jordan
5) Audit prep checklist & owners (5m) — Maya
6) Actions & next steps (5m)
```

Alex: can we flip items 2 and 3 so threat model comes before the RFC? that helps scope crypto choices.

Maya: good call, done. also adding a line for required pre-reads — please upload any diagrams or short notes to the #sec-docs folder before EOD day-before.

Jordan: will upload updated data-flow SVG and a short summary. pinging @Sophie for telemetry retention numbers.

Sophie: sending retention numbers and current retention policy doc link: https://redwood.share/sec/telemetry-retention-v2. will add short one-pager to the folder.

Nate: heads-up for hosts — we should reserve a meeting room with video + recording off by default. compliance wants local recording disabled for sensitive items.

Maya: noted, @Nate can you reserve and set recording off? also adding a line to agenda: `recording policy` (1m).

Nate: done — room booked (Conf B) and recording disabled in calendar invite.

Alex: small ask: can reviewers skim the new key-rotation PR #3421 beforehand? tagging reviewers: @Maya @Sophie @Jordan. it's short.

Maya: will review today.

Sophie: will skim after I drop the telemetry notes.

Jordan: confirmed — reviewers added to PR.

triage-bot: Reaction summary: :one: 2 votes, :two: 3 votes, :three: 1 vote

Maya: looks like Wed 12:30–1:15 wins. locking that slot. final agenda (small tweak): 
```
1) Roll call & objectives (5m)
2) Threat model update & data-flow gaps (12m) — Jordan/Sophie
3) RFC review: key-rotation + canary fallback (10m) — Alex
4) Access review & deprecations (10m) — Jordan
5) Recording policy + meeting notes handling (3m) — Nate
6) Audit prep checklist & owners (3m) — Maya
7) Actions & next steps (2m)
```

Alex: perfect. I'll drop the PR link in the calendar invite and mark the reviewers.

Maya: please also add owners in the invite description and link to the pre-read folder.

Sophie: uploaded telemetry one-pager to #sec-docs. link in calendar description would be great.

Maya: calendar invite sent to attendees. thanks all — see you Wed.

Nate: added conference room details + note about recordings off.

Jordan: thanks — I'll prep the threat-model slides (2 slides) and summary.

Alex: I'll be on for the RFC section and can stay 10 minutes earlier if anyone wants a quick sync.

Maya: awesome. if anything else pops up, thread here. otherwise we're closed. :white_check_mark:
